apps.localizedDescription: Madeira Nightly runs Windows PC games on compatible iPhones using FEX-Emu, Wine, and Metal. This unofficial listing follows camhoc/Madeira releases. Requires JIT; follow the project instructions for device compatibility and setup.

versions.localizedDescription:
**Madeira Nightly 0.2.75**
Everything big since 0.2.32

**Where we were at 0.2.32**
- Built on the older Wine (11.4) and older FEX and DXMT
- Batch uninstall, Move Games, Reset All / Verify All, session menu tabs, mouse lock, auto controller setup, BepInEx mods and Get Game Parts had just landed
- Overwatch 2 didn't get in game
- LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga drew a black world

**Tested and working on our phones**
- **Wine 11.22:** a big under-the-hood update, plus newer FEX and DXMT
- **DirectX 12 games** start and show a picture again
- **Resident Evil Village:** plays full screen, and the intro and prologue videos play (use Wi-Fi, see below)
- **Slay the Spire 2:** black screen fixed
- **Deep Rock Galactic (DX11):** runs great, over 100 FPS in places
- **LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga:** the world draws again
- **Battle.net** launcher opens again
- **Steam** no longer hangs for minutes when it can't connect
- **DirectX badge** shows which DirectX the game really used
- **Console look:** Settings → Appearance → Console look
- **Fewer crashes** in games that start lots of threads

**New, not tested yet (tell us how it goes)**
- **Fallout: New Vegas:** launcher window shows again
- **Satisfactory:** crash at start and the Visual C++ (x64) box fixed
- **Slay the Spire 2:** smoother, built-in setting
- **Vintage Story:** missing graphics fixed
- **Controllers:** more fixes in games
- **Screen and controller hints:** the store title shows once, steadier focus outlines, the hint bar wraps to two rows, and lists and Library buttons clear the hint bar
- **Test Run mode:** off by default
- **OpenAL game sound:** for games that need OpenAL but don't bring their own (BIT.TRIP BEAT and similar)
- **Share Logs** now includes the game's own log files
- **Crash logs** now show the last moments before a crash or freeze
- **Back button** easier to tap in landscape

**Known issues**
- **Deep Rock Galactic:** DX11 works great, but DX12 doesn't start yet. Keep it on DX11.
- **Overwatch 2** and **Black Ops III** don't get in game yet
- **Project Zomboid** can run out of memory when a world loads
- **On cellular**, Steam can go offline after Enable JIT, so some games close. Use Wi-Fi.

Send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks 🙏

Made by camhawk

Support me: [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/camhawk)

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.32**
What's new since 0.2.31
**New**
• **Mouse lock from launch:** Settings → Mouse & keyboard (off by default)
• **Network read/write log** for troubleshooting (off by default)
**Fixes**
• **Move Games** now lists every installed Steam game: Settings → External drives → Move Games
• **Get Help** reads only the game's own folder
• **Project Zomboid** gets its settings outside Steam too
• **iPhone dead strip** fixed: the game window fills the screen
• **Start/cover windows** show instead of staying hidden
• **Off-screen dialogs** are kept on screen
• **More games launch** through the system32 route
**Logging**
• **TV lag** gets its own log line
Send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks 🙏


---

**Support me:** [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/camhawk)

**Battle.net setup guide:** see the attached "Battle.net setup guide.md"

---

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.31**
Everything since 0.2.29
**New**
• **Batch uninstall:** Steam page → Select → pick games → Uninstall
• **Move several games at once:** Settings → External drives → Move Games
• **Reset All / Verify All:** Settings → All games
• **Session menu tabs:** in a game, tap ☰ → Controls / Display / Power
• **Mouse lock:** Settings → Mouse & keyboard
• **Crash debug switch:** on a game's details page
• **Player ID:** next to the app version, sent with Get Help
• **Controllers** set themselves up automatically
• **BepInEx mods** load automatically
• **Get Game Parts:** .NET and Visual C++ in one step
• **"Did it work?"** card after a game closes cleanly
• **Links games open** (like Epic sign-in) open in Safari
• **Clear message** when Enable JIT fails
• **New recommended settings** for GOALS, Portal and .NET programs
**Game fixes**
• **BeamNG.drive** (ARM64): shaders work
• **.NET games** no longer crash at start
• **Battle.net** keeps its settings after Reset
• **Mouse** re-lock, scroll wheel, side buttons 4/5
• **UTF-16 .ini** config files read correctly
**App fixes**
• **No more black-screen freeze** with an external drive plugged in
• **Moving a game** no longer gets stuck on "waiting for cloud activity"
• **Bigger text** in the touch-control editor
• **Reduce Motion** respected
• **Better Get Help** crash reports
• **Six layout and design fixes**
**Known issue**
• **Move Games** doesn't list every game yet. Fixed in the next build.
Send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks 🙏


---

**Support me:** [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/camhawk)

**Install with FlekStore:** https://flekstore.com/madeira

**Battle.net setup guide:** see the attached "Battle.net setup guide.md"

---

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.29**
Battle.net + everything since 0.2.26
**New**
• **Battle.net runs, and StarCraft: Remastered starts from it (setup in the PDF)**
• **.NET 10** in Settings › Runtimes
• **Self-restart loops** (Fallout: NV) are stopped
• **Low-memory message** when iOS gives less memory
**Games**
• **Cyberpunk 2077** starts (D3D12 fix)
• **AC Mirage** passes its Developer Mode check
• **Detroit: Become Human** gets Vulkan
• **Sonic Generations** finds your controller
• **Rust** and **Assetto Corsa** skip their launchers
• **Steep** (Epic) waits for Ubisoft Connect
• **Project DIVA MM+** fits in memory
• **Slay the Spire 2** gets more room to load
• **Black Ops III** sees the real CPU cores
• **Denshattack!** keeps its full memory pool
• **Hades II**, **L.A. Noire**, **The Forest**, **Just Cause 2**: new recommended settings
• **Witcher 3** AVX settings removed
**Fixes**
• **Battle.net** no longer fills the memory pool
• **Move to drive** no longer fails on a good copy
• **Get Help** reports explain the config they show
**Battle.net notes**
• **First start** can stop at the logo: start again
• **Error 2123** + repair on start: let it finish
• **Keep Madeira in front** while it's open
• **Overwatch 2** doesn't start yet, please don't report it
**Logging**
• More detail for **Steam code 42**, **crashes**, **lost mouse input** and **drive libraries**
Send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks 🙏


---

**Support me:** [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/camhawk)

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Madeira uses the local network to pair with this device for JIT, without a computer, and to download Steam games from a PC on this network.
